title: Evaluation after width truncation
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, $C$ a circuit on $n$ variables, $w$ a natural number, and $x\in\{-1,1\}^n$. Retain precisely the first-layer gates of width at most $w$. The truncated circuit's value at $x$ equals the value obtained by evaluating the original later layers with each retained gate's value at $x$ on its corresponding input and each omitted gate assigned the neutral sign for the dual of the first-layer gate type.
